blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Model-generated labels offer a scalable route to training lightweight vision models, but what makes a model a good teacher, and can we tell before training a student? We study this in gaze target estimation, where interactive robots need models that are both accurate and efficient. In a controlled comparison of eleven supervision conditions, we vary only the source of gaze-point labels, keeping the student, training protocol and 361k training samples fixed, across three video datasets, two student sizes and three seeds; every student is evaluated against human annotation. Three findings emerge. First, imperfect model-generated labels can replace human annotation: Gaze-LLE, never trained on the target datasets' gaze annotation, trains students that match annotation-trained ones on ViT-Tiny and are significantly more accurate on ViT-Small (average distance error 0.187 vs 0.196), and the ViT-Tiny student runs 32$\times$ faster than its teacher on a laptop CPU. Second, apparent competence can conceal unreliable supervision: given another person's face centre in the prompt, InternVL3 and Qwen3-VL return it on 93.4% and 81.1% of test samples, and a copy-the-coordinate baseline matches InternVL3's labels and students. Without that coordinate, both models fall far behind the specialist. Third, good teachers can be identified before training: validation label error ranks student test error (Spearman's $ρ= 0.91$), and ten annotated clips single out the two specialist teachers in 95% of draws. These findings give practical principles for assessing supervision, exposing shortcuts and selecting teachers for lightweight models.
blocks.zh: 模型生成的标签为训练轻量级视觉模型提供了一个可伸缩的路径,但是什么使得模型成为优秀的老师,在训练学生之前我们能分辨出来? 我们在观察目标估计时研究了这一点, 在那里,交互式机器人需要准确有效的模型。 在对11个监管条件进行控制比较时,我们只改变视点标签的来源,使学生、培训规程和361k培训样本固定在3个视频数据集、2个学生大小和3个种子之间;每个学生都根据人的注释进行评估。 得出了三个结论。 首先,不完善的模型生成标签可以取代人类注释: Gaze-LLE,从未接受过目标数据集的注音训练,在ViT-Tiny上培训与注音训练的学生,在ViT-Small(平均距离误差0.187对0.196)上则明显更准确,而ViT-Tiny学生在笔记本电脑CPU上运行的32美元\\tims快于其老师. 其次,明显的胜任能力可能隐藏不可靠的监督:鉴于他人的面部中心在即时,InternVL3和Qun3-VL在测试样本的93.4%和81.1%上还原了它,并且复制坐标基线与InternVL3的标签和学生相匹配. 没有这个坐标 两个模型都远远落后于专家 第三,在培训前可以识别优秀教师:验证标签错误将学生测试出错(Spearman's $ρ= 0.91$)排行榜,10个附加说明的片段在95%的图纸中将两位专业教师单独列出. 这些调查结果提出了评估监督、披露捷径和挑选教师从事轻量级模式的实用原则。

blocks.en:
Robots that interact with people must estimate where a person is looking, as gaze supports behaviours such as turn-taking and joint attention [ 2 ] and anticipating a partner’s intent in collaborative tasks [ 24 ] .
At the same time, robots often operate under strict computational constraints, requiring lightweight gaze models that can run locally, without relying on a network connection.
Training such models, however, typically depends on large quantities of annotated video, and obtaining frame-level gaze targets is laborious and costly.
As a result, collecting annotation can become a bottleneck in developing deployable gaze models.
blocks.zh:
与人互动的机器人必须估计一个人的视线所在,因为视线支持诸如转动和共同关注等行为[2],并预测伴侣在协作任务中的意图[24]。
同时,机器人经常在严格的计算限制下运行,需要轻量级的凝视模型可以在当地运行,而不依赖于网络连接.
然而,培训这种模式通常取决于大量附加说明的视频,获得帧式的视线目标既费力又昂贵。
因此,收集注释可能成为发展可部署的目视模型的瓶颈。

blocks.en:
Model-generated labels are commonly used in place of manual annotation [ 26 , 49 , 44 ] .
For gaze target estimation, potential teachers include specialist gaze models trained on external datasets, such as Gaze-LLE [ 37 ] and MTGS [ 20 ] , vision-language models (VLMs) that can be prompted to predict gaze targets [ 45 , 47 ] , and open-vocabulary detectors that localise named objects [ 28 ] .
It remains unclear which teacher sources produce the strongest students, and whether teacher quality can be estimated before training.
Labels can look plausible yet still mislead a student; strong agreement with a teacher’s labels may not translate into agreement with the target annotation ( Section 6 ).
Whereas recent work evaluates VLMs directly as gaze predictors [ 45 ] , we focus on the effectiveness of all three as teachers for a lightweight gaze student.
blocks.zh:
模型生成的标签通常用于代替手动注释[26,49,44].
就目视目标估计而言,潜在的教师包括受过外部数据集培训的专家目视模型,如Gaze-LLE[37]和MTGS[20],可促使预测目视目标[45,47]的视觉语言模型,以及可定位指定物体的露天探测器[28]。
仍然不清楚哪些教师来源培养出最强的学生,在培训前是否可以对教师质量进行估计。
标签看起来可以令人信服,但仍会误导学生;与教师标签的强烈一致可能不会转化为与目标注释的一致(第6节)。
近期的作品直接评价VLM作为凝视预测器[45],

blocks.en:
We perform a controlled comparison in which the student architecture, training procedure, and 361,045 training rows are fixed, and only the source of the coordinate labels varies (eleven sources; Table 1 ).
Experiments span three datasets (VAT, ChildPlay and VACATION), two student sizes, ViT-Tiny (5.7M parameters) and ViT-Small (21.9M), and three random seeds.
All students are evaluated against the target datasets’ own gaze annotation (51,591 test rows), with significance assessed using a paired bootstrap over test clips.
blocks.zh:
我们进行对照比较,将学生建筑、培训程序和361 045个培训行固定下来,只有坐标标签的来源不同(均匀来源;表1)。
实验跨越三个数据集(VAT,ChildPlay和VACATION),两个学生大小,Vit-Tiny(5.7M参数)和Vit-Small(21.9M),以及三个随机种子.
所有学生都根据目标数据集自己的注解(51,591个测试行)来评估,其意义用双靴子而不是测试片段来评估。

blocks.en:
We report three main findings.
First, the specialist gaze model Gaze-LLE, despite never being trained on the target datasets’ gaze annotation, produces students that match or exceed those trained on the datasets’ own annotation, with significantly lower error on ViT-Small (0.187 vs 0.196; Section 4 ).
Because Gaze-LLE requires 44 × \times the ViT-Tiny student’s compute, it is used once, offline, to generate training labels.
Second, prompt leakage can create a false impression of gaze understanding: when its prompt includes another person’s face centre, InternVL3 reproduces that coordinate in 93.4% of its test labels, and Qwen3-VL behaves the same way.
A baseline that simply returns the supplied coordinate exposes this behaviour, and removing the leak reveals a substantial gap between general-purpose VLMs and specialist gaze models ( Section 5 ).
Third, a teacher’s label error, measured in seconds before any training, closely ranks student performance (Spearman’s ρ = 0.91 \rho=0.91 ; Section 6 ), and ten annotated clips are enough to identify the best teachers.
The results also show that confidence gating is no better than random replacement, and that apparent temporal gains come almost entirely from biased teachers rather than anticipation ( Section 6 ).
blocks.zh:
我们报告三个主要调查结果。
首先,专家的凝视模型Gaze-LLE尽管从未接受过目标数据集的凝视注解培训,却培养出与数据集自身注解所训练的学生相匹配或超过的学生,在ViT-Small(0.187诉0.196;第4节)上的误差明显较低。
因为Gaze-LLE需要44×\时ViT-Tiny学生的计算,所以一度被下线,用来生成训练标签.
第二,即时渗漏会给目光理解造成错误印象:当它的迅速包括另一个人的脸部中心时,InternVL3会复制协调其93.4%的测试标签,而Qune3-VL的行为也一样。
简单地返回提供的坐标的基线暴露了这种行为,消除漏泄揭示了通用甚高频和专家视距模型之间的巨大差距(第5节)。
第三,教师的标签错误,在任何培训前几秒钟衡量,对学生的成绩进行严格排序(Spearman ^ 0.91\rho= 0.91;第6节),还有十段附加说明的片段足以确定最好的教师。
调查结果还表明,信心的取舍并不比随机替代更好,而且明显的时间收益几乎完全来自偏执的教师而不是预期(第6节)。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We show that a specialist gaze model never trained on the target datasets’ gaze annotation can replace it when training lightweight gaze students, at both sizes, with or without head-position input. • We identify a hidden pitfall in VLM-based gaze labelling: prompt leakage can create the appearance of competence while the model largely reproduces the supplied coordinate, which a simple copy-the-coordinate baseline exposes. • We show that teacher quality can be estimated before student training from label error measured on only a few annotated clips and give three practical recommendations for evaluating model-generated supervision. We will release the label sets, code and evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们显示,在训练轻量级的视线学生时,无论大小,无论有无头部位置,专家视线模型都从未在目标数据集的视线注解上受过训练。 我们在基于VLM的凝视标签中发现了一个隐蔽的陷阱:即时渗漏可以产生能力外观,而模型则基本上复制了所提供的坐标,一个简单的坐标基准可以暴露出来。 我们表明,在对学生进行培训之前,可从仅用几个附加说明的片段测量的标签错误中估算出教师的质量,并为评价模型产生的监督提出了三项切实可行的建议。 我们将发布标签、代码和评估协议。

blocks.en: 2. Related work
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 相关工作

blocks.en:
Gaze target estimation predicts where a person in an image is looking [ 36 ] .
Prior work has extended this setting to video and out-of-frame gaze targets [ 9 , 10 ] and to children [ 41 ] .
Methods include transformers for multi-person gaze target estimation [ 43 , 42 ] , temporal and social-gaze models [ 20 ] , and light decoders on frozen foundation encoders [ 37 ] .
Recent work has improved gaze reasoning to reduce reliance on salient objects [ 46 ] or introduced promptable gaze target estimation, where textual or visual prompts specify the person of interest [ 7 ] .
Research has also explored social attention in robotics [ 16 , 1 ] .
Unlike these gaze models, which are typically trained on the target benchmarks, we compare sources of model-generated supervision for lightweight gaze students and judge the students against the target annotation.
blocks.zh:
Gaze目标估计预测图像中一个人的外观位置[36].
先前的工作将这一背景扩大到视频和范围外的目视目标[9、10]和儿童[41]。
方法包括多人凝视目标估计的变压器[43,42],时间模型和社会-gaze模型[20],以及冷冻地基编码器上的光解码器[37].
最近的工作改进了凝视推理,以减少对显著物体的依赖[46]或引入了快速凝视目标估计,其中文字或视觉提示指定了感兴趣的人[7].
研究还探索了机器人学的社会关注[16, 1].
与这些通常接受目标基准培训的目视模型不同,我们比较了轻量级目视学生模型产生的监督来源,并根据目标注释判断学生.

blocks.en:
VLMs have been used to extract contextual cues that improve gaze-following models [ 21 ] and have been fine-tuned or prompted to describe and locate gaze targets [ 47 , 31 ] .
A controlled study reports that 94 of the 111 models tested fail to do better than random guessing at identifying the object a person is looking at, while humans achieve near-ceiling accuracy [ 53 ] .
A benchmark of VLMs as gaze predictors finds that zero-shot Qwen3-VL-8B has more than twice the error of Gaze-LLE on GazeFollow [ 45 ] .
Whereas these studies evaluate or improve VLMs as gaze predictors, we evaluate them as sources of supervision for lightweight students.
We further identify a shortcut not reported in these works: a prompt that contains a candidate answer lets a VLM appear competent by copying it, a behaviour exposed by a copy-the-coordinate baseline.
blocks.zh:
VLM被用于提取背景提示,改进跟踪目视模式[21],并经过微调或促使描述和定位目视目标[47,31].
一项受控的研究表明,在所测试的111个模型中,有94个未能比随机猜测更能识别一个人正在观察的物体,而人类则能达到接近上限的准确性[53].
VLMs作为瞪羚预测器的基准发现,零射速Qwen3-VL-8B在GazeFlows[45]上的Gaze-LLE的误差超过两倍.
虽然这些研究评价或改进了视线预测仪,但我们评价它们为轻量级学生的监督来源。
我们进一步确定在这些作品中没有报告的捷径:包含一个候选答案的提示让一个VLM通过复制而显得胜任,一个复制坐标基线暴露的行为.

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a teacher model to a smaller student [ 23 , 19 ] .
Students can match or exceed a teacher of the same size [ 17 ] , while teacher-student capacity gaps, optimisation and training duration influence outcomes [ 8 , 32 , 39 , 5 ] .
Model-generated supervision is also used through pseudo-labelling, self-training and transfer from vision foundation models [ 26 , 49 , 44 ] .
In gaze target estimation, PaGE trains a DINOv3-based teacher on the labelled training sets of GazeFollow, VAT and ChildPlay, reported to reach human-level accuracy, then distils lightweight students on unlabelled images (MPII, OpenImages V7) and fine-tunes them on the same labelled training sets [ 50 ] .
Distillation has also been applied to near-eye eye tracking for AR/VR [ 25 ] and to robots for social navigation [ 13 ] and proactive interaction [ 11 ] .
Unlike PaGE, which uses target-dataset annotation to train both teacher and students, we treat that annotation as one competing source of supervision, evaluate whether existing models can replace it, and score each teacher’s labels against it before student training.
blocks.zh:
知识蒸馏将知识从师范模式转移给较小的学生[23,19].
学生可以匹配或超过同等规模的教师[17],而师生能力差距、优化和培训期限则影响结果[8、32、39、5]。
模型产生的监督也通过伪标签、自我培训和从视觉基础模型转移[26、49、44]使用。
在目光目标估计中,PaGE在GazeFaflow、增值税和ChildPlay这几套标签培训中培训了一名基于DINov3的教师,据报告他们达到人的水平准确度,然后在无标签的图像(MPII、OpenImages V7)上对轻量级学生进行提炼,并在同一套标签的培训中对其进行微调[50]。
蒸馏还应用于AR/VR的近眼眼跟踪[25]和用于社会导航的机器人[13]和主动互动[11].
与PaGE不同, PaGE使用目标数据集注释来培训师生, 我们把该注释作为相互竞争的监管来源, 评价现有模型能否取代,

blocks.en:
A substantial body of work studies learning under noisy supervision [ 38 ] : deep networks can memorise even random labels [ 51 ] but tend to learn clean patterns first [ 3 , 27 ] .
Softened targets such as label smoothing prevent over-confidence [ 40 , 33 ] .
Other methods select likely-clean samples by their loss [ 22 ] , identify label errors from predicted probabilities [ 34 ] , or weight teachers by their confidence against ground truth [ 52 ] .
Evaluation protocols can also change conclusions, through benchmark variance [ 6 ] or metrics that suggest a success that does not hold, as in machine unlearning [ 18 ] .
Whereas noisy-label methods seek to make training robust, we measure label error against the annotation before training, show that confidence-guided replacement is no better than random replacement at a matched rate, and derive recommendations for evaluating model-generated supervision.
blocks.zh:
大量的工作研究在吵闹的监督下学习[38]: 深层网络可以记忆甚至随机标签[51],但倾向于先学习干净的图案[3,27].
标签平滑等软化目标防止过度自信[40,33].
其他方法通过损失选择可能干净的样本[22],从预测概率中识别标签错误[34],或者通过对地面真理的信任来识别加权教师[52].
评价协议还可以通过基准差异[6]或衡量标准改变结论,如机器不学习[18]。
虽然高音标签方法力求使培训有力,但我们在培训前对照注解衡量标签错误,表明以相应的速度随机更换信心制导的替换并不比随机替换更好,并为评价模型产生的监督提出建议。

blocks.en:
We use three datasets: VideoAttentionTarget (VAT) [ 10 ] , ChildPlay [ 41 ] and VACATION [ 14 ] .
All provide per-person gaze-target annotations.
For VAT and ChildPlay, the gaze type is derived from the annotation: social , if the gaze point lies inside another person’s head box; off-screen , if the annotation places the target outside the frame; otherwise object .
VACATION’s annotations contain no gaze points; instead its ‘attention-focus’ field states the person or object being looked at.
We use the target bounding-box centre as ground truth (social if it is a person’s face, object otherwise).
Rows (one person in one frame) with ambiguous or undefined targets are dropped, yielding 51,591 on-screen test rows (VAT 19,563; ChildPlay 20,100; VACATION 11,928) and 6,687 off-screen test rows (VAT only).
We apply their canonical split for all datasets except VAT’s validation set, where we use the split MTGS uses [ 41 , 20 ] , ensuring no frame or clip appears in more than one partition.

blocks.en:
Vision-language models. InternVL3-8B [ 54 ] with greedy decoding is tested with two prompts. No-leak : the model is shown the frame and person A’s head box and asked for the point A is looking at: a face centre if the target is a person, an object centre otherwise. Leaky : the model is also given the head box and face centre of another annotated person in the scene, ‘person B’ (chosen without reference to the gaze annotation).
The prompt asks the model to return that centre if A is looking at B. Copy-B always returns the supplied coordinate, providing the results the leaky VLM would produce if it only copied (prompts: supplementary).
Qwen3-VL-8B [ 4 ] is run with the same two prompts and evaluated at label level only ( Section 5 ).

blocks.en:
Detector-assisted labels. VLM+OVD pairs InternVL3-8B with an open-vocabulary detector (OVD), Grounding DINO (base) [ 28 ] .
Social rows default to the VLM’s answer; for object rows, the VLM names the target from the frame alone, without being told whose gaze to estimate, and Grounding DINO’s highest-scoring box for that target is used.
While the no-leak version always accepts this box, the leaky version retains the detector’s thresholds, falling back to the annotation if no box passes them or the VLM names no object.
Two controls test confidence gating: gated replaces a detector label with the annotation if its score falls below 0.55, whereas random swap replaces an identical number of labels but selects the rows at random.
This comparison is repeated at thresholds 0.40, 0.48 and 1 (supplementary).
The image-centre baseline always predicts the centre of the image.
Whilst every source uses annotated head boxes and off-screen flags, teachers only use annotation in four situations: VLM+OVD’s routing by gaze type; VAT frames without a person B (leaky VLM and copy-B; 3.4% of VAT training rows); leaky VLM+OVD’s fall-backs (1.3% of training rows); and the gating controls.
blocks.zh:
探测器辅助标签。 VLM+OVD配对 InternVL3-8B配有开源性探测器(OVD),地面DINO(基座)[28].
社会行默认为 VLM 的答案; 对于对象行, VLM 将目标从框中单独命名, 而不被告知谁的目光来估计, 并且将 DINO 的最高评分框用于该目标 。
虽然无漏版本总是接受这个框,但漏出版本保留了探测器的阈值,如果没有盒通过它们,或者VLM名称没有对象,则回落到注释中.
两种控件测试置信度标注: 闸口如果分数低于0.55,则用注号替换探测器标签,而随机互换则替换相同数量的标签,但随机选择行.
这种比较在0.40、0.48和1(补充)的阈值上重复。
图像中心基线总是预测图像中心.
虽然每个来源都使用注解头盒和屏幕外旗,但教师只在四种情况下使用注解:VLM+OVD的视线类型;没有B人的增值税框架(leaky VLM和copy-B;增值税培训行的3.4%);漏报的VLM+OVD的倒置(培训行的1.3%);以及标注控制。

blocks.en:
Two students, ViT-Tiny (5.7M parameters) and ViT-Small (21.9M parameters) [ 12 ] (patch size 16, ImageNet-pretrained weights from timm [ 48 ] ), take two inputs: the full image (resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 ) and a crop of the subject’s head ( 112 × 112 112\times 112 upsampled to 224 × 224 224\times 224 ).
The class tokens are concatenated and passed through a two-layer MLP (LayerNorm, GELU, dropout), to a sigmoid output ( gaze point ) and a logit for off-screen prediction.
Each student’s input includes neither a head-position map nor any other person’s box.
A variant additionally receives head position ( Section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
两个学生,ViT-Tiny(5.7M参数)和ViT-Small(21.9M参数)[12](patch size 16,ImageNet-presented rights from Timm [48]),取了两个投入:全图像(缩写为224×224/224\times 224)和一粒主体头部(112×112112112\tims 112上标为224×224/224\tims 224).
班级的代号是缩合的,经过一个双层的MLP(LayerNorm,GELU,退赛),到一个sigmoid输出(凝视点)和一个用于屏幕外预测的登录.
每个学生的投入既不包括头部位置图,也不包括任何其他人的盒子。
变体额外接收头部位置(第4节)。

blocks.en:
For on-screen targets, the coordinate loss is Smooth- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} .
Off-screen output uses binary cross-entropy (weight 1).
For every condition, the off-screen flag comes from the annotation.
Training uses AdamW [ 30 ] (learning rate 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} ), batch size 32, and cosine decay [ 29 ] to 1% of the initial rate over 15 epochs.
All conditions are trained with three seeds: 42, 88 and 137 (full recipe: supplementary).
blocks.zh:
对于屏幕上的目标,坐标损失是平滑的 - l 1\ell\\1}.
外屏幕输出使用二进制交叉切变(重量1).
对于每个条件,外屏旗都来自注释.
训练使用AdamW [30](学习率3×10−5 3\times 10×5},体重衰减 1×10−4 1\times 10×4}),批量大小32,以及余弦衰减[29]到15个纪元以上初始速率的1%.
所有条件都经过三种种子的培训:42、88和137(完整的食谱:补充)。

blocks.en:
We select each student’s epoch using its validation error against its own training labels (selection on ground truth: supplementary).
Students are then scored against the annotated gaze point, not the teacher’s prediction.
We report the Average Distance Error (ADE) between predicted and annotated points, in image coordinates normalised to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , as mean ± \pm standard deviation over the three seeds, and the Percentage of Correct Keypoints at 0.1 (PCK .1 ), the fraction of predictions within 0.1 of the annotated point ( Section 6 ).
We then test the differences between sources with a paired bootstrap [ 15 ] over 172 test clips on seed-averaged per-row errors (10,000 resamples, 95% intervals).
Differences are computed from unrounded errors, so they can differ by 0.001 from the rounded values in the tables.
For the temporal heads ( Section 6 ), the architecture is chosen on a held-out fold of the test clips, after which the chosen head is evaluated on a separate fold (five-fold cross-fitting).
The off-screen decision threshold is chosen on validation (maximum F1), then applied unchanged to test (results: Section 6 ).
blocks.zh:
校对:Soup
而不是老师的预测。
我们报告预测点和附加说明点之间的平均距离误差(ADE),以图像坐标表示为[0, 1] [0, 1],作为三个种子的平均值±\pm标准偏差,以及0.1的正确关键点百分比(PCK.1),即附加说明点0.1范围内的预测(第6节)的一小部分。
然后,我们根据平均每组种子误差(10 000个复标,95%间隔),测试配对靴子[15] 超过172个试验片段的来源之间的差异。
差异是根据未四舍五入的误差计算的,因此它们可以与表中的四舍五入的数值相差0.01。
对于时间头(第6节),架构选择在测试片段的悬空折叠上,之后选择的片头用单独的折叠(5倍的交叉配对)来评价.
屏外决定阈值是在验证(最大F1)时选择的,然后在测试时保持不变(结果:第6节)。

blocks.en:
MTGS was trained on VSGaze [ 20 ] , which incorporates VAT and ChildPlay.
Consequently, labels generated on these training rows may partly reproduce their annotation.
Since our partitions match MTGS’s splits, none of our test rows are in its training data.
VACATION is unseen by MTGS, allowing it to be used as a held-out check.
Gaze-LLE has never been trained on the target datasets’ gaze annotation: its decoder was fitted only on GazeFollow, a still-image dataset, and its DINOv2 backbone is frozen.
The training data of DINOv2, the VLMs and Grounding DINO is web-scale and not fully disclosed, making overlap with the target datasets difficult to assess.
blocks.zh:
MTGS接受了VSGaze[20]的培训,该培训纳入了增值税和ChildPlay。
因此,在这些培训栏上产生的标签可能会部分地重复其注释。
我们的分区与MTGS的分区一致,
MTGS看不到VACATION,允许它用作搁置检查.
Gaze-LLE从未接受过目标数据集的注解训练:它的解码器只安装在GazeFollow上,
DINOv2的培训数据,VLMs和Grounding DINO是网络尺度的,没有完全披露,使得与目标数据集的重叠难以评估.

blocks.en: 4. A specialist teacher can replace target gaze-point annotation
blocks.zh: 4个 专业老师可以代替目标视点注释

blocks.en:
Gaze-LLE was never trained on the target datasets’ gaze annotation, yet students trained on its labels match or exceed those trained on that annotation ( Table 2 ).
ViT-Tiny students are comparable (ADE 0.204 vs 0.208), whilst ViT-Small students are significantly more accurate (ADE 0.187 vs 0.196), with all nine seed pairings favouring Gaze-LLE.
blocks.zh:
Gaze-LLE从未接受过目标数据集的注解培训,但接受过标签培训的学生与接受过该注解培训的学生相匹配或超过他们(表2)。
ViT-Tiny学生具有可比性(ADE 0.204 vs 0.208),而ViT-Small学生的准确性显著提高(ADE 0.187 vs 0.196),所有9个种子配对都倾向于Gaze-LLE.

blocks.en:
MTGS mirrors Gaze-LLE’s results for both students (ADE 0.204 on ViT-Tiny, 0.185 on ViT-Small).
Because it was trained on VAT and ChildPlay, VACATION is its held-out check, where it matches the annotation on ViT-Tiny (0.216 vs 0.223; Table 3 ).
blocks.zh:
MTGS反映了Gaze-LLE对两个学生的成绩(ADE 0.204 on ViT-Tiny, 0.185 on ViT-Small).
由于VACATION接受了增值税和ChildPlay方面的培训,因此VACATION是其持有的支票,与Vit-Tiny的注释(0.216对0.223;表3)相符。

blocks.en:
Despite differing from the human gaze-point annotation (test label error 0.099 for MTGS and 0.114 for Gaze-LLE), specialist teachers produce students that perform comparably to, and in some configurations better than, those trained on the annotation.
Gaze-LLE’s labels are easier to fit: students trained on Gaze-LLE reproduce its labels more closely than annotation-trained students reproduce the annotation (0.191 vs 0.208 on ViT-Tiny, significant for both student sizes).
A teacher’s effectiveness may therefore depend not only on its agreement with the annotation, but also on how easily a student can fit its labels. Figure 1 shows a pattern consistent with this possibility: differences in label error between relatively accurate teachers translate into comparatively small differences in student performance, whereas larger teacher errors are more strongly reflected in performance.
blocks.zh:
尽管与人类的视点注释不同(MTGS测试标签错误0.099,Gaze-LLE测试错误0.114),但专业教师培养的学生与接受过注释培训的学生相比,在某些配置上表现优于他们。
Gaze-LLE的标签比较容易贴合:受过Gaze-LLE培训的学生比受过注解训练的学生更仔细地复制其标签(ViT-Tiny上的0. 191 vs 0.208,对于两个学生大小都很重要)。
因此,教师的有效性可能不仅取决于其是否同意注释,还取决于学生如何容易符合其标签。 图1显示了一种与这种可能性相一致的模式:相对准确的教师之间的标签错误差异转化为学生成绩的相对小的差别,而较大的教师错误则更强烈地反映在成绩中.

blocks.en:
Students trained on teacher and annotation labels may appear comparable only because the student is the bottleneck: it sees the head crop, but not the head’s location within the image.
To test this, we retrained ViT-Tiny students on three sources (annotation, Gaze-LLE, no-leak VLM) and ViT-Small students on two (annotation, Gaze-LLE), adding the head’s position in the frame as an input ( Table 4 ).
This significantly improves the ViT-Tiny students trained on the annotation ( − - 0.009) and on Gaze-LLE ( − - 0.010), but not those trained on the no-leak VLM (0.000, not significant): a better-informed student cannot compensate for inaccurate labels.
For ViT-Tiny with head position, Gaze-LLE’s students remain comparable to the annotation’s (ADE 0.193 vs 0.199).
For ViT-Small, the added input helps the annotation-trained students more than the Gaze-LLE-trained ones ( − - 0.010 vs − - 0.004, both significant), narrowing Gaze-LLE’s advantage to a difference that is not significant (ADE 0.183 vs 0.186).
Gaze-LLE therefore matches the annotation even with a better-informed student.
blocks.zh:
接受过教师和注解标签培训的学生可能看起来是相当的,因为学生是瓶颈:学生看到头部作物,但不看到头部在图像中的位置。
为了测试这一点,我们对ViT-Tiny学生进行了三个来源(注解,Gaze-LLE,无漏VLM)和两个来源(注解,Gaze-LLE)的ViT-Small学生的再培训,在框中增加了头部的位置作为输入(表4).
这大大改进了接受过注解(-0.009)和Gaze-LLE(-0.010)培训的ViT-Tiny学生,但没有接受过无漏VLM(0.000,不显著)培训的学生:了解更多信息的学生不能补偿不准确的标签。
对于头部位置的ViT-Tiny,Gaze-LLE的学生仍然与注释(ADE 0.193 vs 0.199)相当.
对ViT-Small来说,增加的投入比Gaze-LLE训练的学生(−-0.010对−-0.04)更有助于注解训练的学生,两者都具有重大意义,将Gaze-LLE的优势缩小到不显著的差别(ADE 0.183对0.186)。
因此,Gaze-LLE甚至与一个更知情的学生的注释相符。

blocks.en:
Gaze-LLE is more accurate than any student model (test label error 0.114), but it needs 44 × \times the ViT-Tiny student’s compute, which makes direct deployment impractical without a GPU ( Table 5 ).
On a 2021 laptop, Gaze-LLE is 32 × \times slower than ViT-Tiny on the CPU (1,077 vs 34 ms per frame) and 5.2 × \times slower on the GPU.
The most practical approach is to use Gaze-LLE only once, offline, to generate training targets, while the student model provides the efficiency required for deployment to a robot.
blocks.zh:
Gaze-LLE比任何学生模型(测试标签错误0.114)更准确,但它需要44×\时ViT-Tiny学生的计算,这使得没有GPU的直接部署不切实际(表5).
在一台2021年的笔记本电脑上,Gaze-LLE在CPU上比Vit-Tiny慢32×xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
最实用的方法是只使用一次Gaze-LLE,离线生成训练目标,而学生模式则提供向机器人部署所需的效率.

blocks.en: 5. When the prompt contains the answer
blocks.zh: 5.五. 当提示包含答案时

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Labels from three teachers on typical test frames. Eight test frames from VAT and VACATION, chosen so that every source’s label error is close to its median for that gaze type (not best cases); lines run from person A’s head to each label. The leaky VLM’s label lands on person B’s face, the coordinate in its prompt: correct on social gaze, wrong on object gaze. Gaze-LLE is close in all eight.

blocks.en:
When given the leaky prompt, which includes another person’s face centre, a VLM appears to be competent on social gaze, but it is mostly coordinate copying rather than gaze reasoning ( Fig. 2 ).
InternVL3 reproduces that point almost exactly (to within 0.001) on 93.4% of test rows with a person B, ranging from 89.8% on ChildPlay to 96.8% on VAT.
Copy-B ( Section 3 ), which always returns the supplied coordinate, exposes this behaviour: both the generated labels and the resulting students match those obtained from the VLM.
Label error is nearly identical (ADE 0.286 vs 0.284), and students trained on these labels are not significantly different at either size (ViT-Tiny 0.291 vs 0.294).
These students are about as accurate as always predicting the image centre (0.294).
blocks.zh:
包括另一个人的脸部中心在内的泄密的瞬间,VLM似乎在社会视线上是胜任的,但大多是坐标复制而不是凝视推理(图2)。
InternVL3几乎完全照搬(到0.001年间)在93.4%的测试列上与一个人的B,从89.8%的ChildPlay到96.8%的增值税。
Copy-B(第3节),它总是返回所提供的坐标,它暴露了这种行为:生成的标签和由此产生的学生都与从VLM获得的相匹配.
标签错误几乎完全相同(ADE 02.86 vs 0.284),接受过这些标签培训的学生无论大小(ViT-Tiny 0.291 vs 0.294)都没有显著区别.
这些学生的准确性与对影像中心的预测一样高(0.294).

blocks.en:
On social rows, the leaky labels look accurate (label error 0.149, copy-B 0.138) because the supplied face centre is usually the answer.
When A looks at another person, that person is often B, and in two-person scenes it can only be B.
On object rows, where the supplied face centre is never the answer, the leaky labels are far worse than the image centre (0.403 vs 0.302).
blocks.zh:
在社交行中,漏出的标签看起来准确(标签错误0.149,副本-B0.138),因为所提供的面部中心通常是答案.
当A看另一个人时,那个人经常是B,在两人的场景中只能是B.
在对象行上,所供给的面部中心从来不是答案,漏出的标签远不如图像中心(0.403 vs 0.302).

blocks.en:
With the same leaky prompt, Qwen3-VL-8B reproduces the supplied face centre on 81.1% of the same rows, ranging from 60.5% on ChildPlay to 97.4% on VAT (InternVL3: 93.4%; Table 6 ).
Copying is therefore the dominant behaviour for both models, but its prevalence depends on the model and data, which is why the copy-B check should be run for each.
blocks.zh:
Quen3-VL-8B在同一个排位中81.1%的排位上复制了供应的面部中心,从ChildPlay的60.5%到增值税的97.4%不等(InternVL3:93.4%;表6)。
因此,复制是两种模型的主要行为,但其流行程度取决于模型和数据,这就是为什么每个模型都应该运行复制-B检查.

blocks.en:
InternVL3 produces labels that are less accurate than predicting the image centre on every dataset and both gaze types (label error 0.334 vs 0.294), and students trained on these labels also underperform the centre at both sizes (ViT-Tiny 0.333 vs 0.294).
In contrast, Qwen3-VL surpasses the image-centre baseline (0.247 vs 0.294), indicating that it extracts some gaze information directly from the image.
However, its label error remains about twice that of Gaze-LLE (0.114).
Thus, without the leak, both general-purpose VLMs remain substantially less accurate than a specialist gaze model.
blocks.zh:
InternVL3产生的标签比预测每个数据集的图像中心以及双眼类型(标签错误0.334 vs 0.294)的准确度要低,而接受过这些标签培训的学生在两个大小上都对中心表现不佳(ViT-Tiny 0.333 vs 0.294).
相比之下,Qune3-VL超过了图像-中心基线(0.247 vs 0.294),表明它直接从图像中提取一些凝视信息.
然而,其标签错误仍为Gaze-LLE(0.114)的两倍左右.
因此,没有漏水,这两种通用的甚高频的准确度都远远低于专业的视线模型。

blocks.en:
The apparent accuracy of VLM-generated labels can partly arise from information supplied in the prompt rather than independently inferred from visual evidence.
This distinction is particularly important when VLMs are used as teachers, as downstream students may inherit systematic shortcuts embedded in their supervision.
Comparing VLM outputs against a simple baseline that directly reproduces the supplied coordinates therefore provides a practical diagnostic for shortcut exploitation.
More broadly, predictive accuracy alone may be insufficient to establish the reliability of model-generated supervision when candidate answers are embedded in the input.
blocks.zh:
VLM生成的标签的明显准确性可以部分来自即时提供的信息,而不是从视觉证据中独立推断出来的.
当VLM被用作教师时,这种区分尤其重要,因为下游学生可能继承嵌入在他们监管中的系统捷径.
因此,将VLM的输出量与直接复制所提供坐标的简单基线相比较,为快捷方式的开发提供了实用的诊断。
更广义地说,在输入中嵌入候选答案时,单靠预测准确性可能不足以确定模型产生的监督的可靠性.

blocks.en: 6. Checking model-generated labels before and after training
blocks.zh: 6个 培训前后检查模型生成的标签

blocks.en:
Label error is an inexpensive proxy that reliably separates coarse differences in student performance.
Scoring a label set against the annotation involves no student training, takes seconds and closely ranks performance ( Fig. 1 , Table 2 ).
Across the ten label sources other than the annotation (whose label error is zero by definition), Spearman’s rank correlation between validation label error and student test error is 0.91 (ViT-Tiny) and 0.90 (ViT-Small).
The check also needs little annotated data: with 10 randomly selected validation clips (about 4,800 frames, 1.3% of the 361,045 training rows), the two specialist teachers rank highest in 95% of 2,000 random draws; with 20 clips, in 99%.
Training on specialist labels uses no target-dataset gaze-point annotation; selecting a strong teacher requires only a small annotated sample.
blocks.zh:
标签错误是一种廉价的代词,可以可靠地区分学生表现的粗糙差异.
对照注解对标签进行校标,不进行学生培训,要花几秒钟,并严格排列成绩(图1,表2)。
除了注解(其标签误差按定义为零)之外,斯皮尔曼在验证标签误差和学生测试误差之间的排名关联是0.91(ViT-Tiny)和0.90(ViT-Small).
该检查也很少需要附加说明的数据:有10个随机选取的验证片段(约4,800帧,361,045个培训行中的1.3%),两位专业教师在2000个随机抽取的95%中排名最高;有20个片段,占99%.
关于专业标签的培训没有使用目标数据集的凝视点注释;选择强师只需要少量注解样本.

blocks.en:
Gating replaces low-confidence detector labels with the annotation ( Section 3 ), but the label check shows that confidence does not identify incorrect labels.
When the same share of detector labels (52%) is replaced, confidence-guided replacement performs worse than replacing at random (object label error 0.134 vs 0.118; Table 2 ).
Consistent with this, confidence gating is never significantly better across six student-training tests (three thresholds × \times two sizes), while random replacement is significantly better twice (ViT-Tiny at 0.55, − - 0.006; ViT-Small at 0.40, − - 0.006; supplementary).
Replacing every detector label with the annotation makes the object labels almost perfect (object label error 0.019, test rows), yet the students stay far from the annotation-trained ones (ViT-Tiny 0.261 vs 0.208; ViT-Small 0.260 vs 0.196): the no-leak VLM’s social labels (label error 0.325), not the detector, hold these students back.
blocks.zh:
Gating用注解(第3节)取代低自信探测器标签,但标签检查显示,信心不能识别不正确的标签.
当更换相同比例的探测器标签(52%)时,置信制导替换的性能比随机替换更差(对象标签错误0.134对0.118;表2 )。
与此一致的是,在6个学生培训测试中,信任度一直没有明显提高(3个阈值×\times two size),而随机替换则明显提高两次(ViT-Tiny在0.55−-0.006;ViT-Small在0.40−-0.006;补充)。
用注释取代每一个检测器标签,使得对象标签几乎完美(对象标签错误0.019,测试行),然而学生远离注释训练的标签(ViT-Tiny 0.261 vs 0.208;ViT-Small 0260 vs 0.196):无漏VLM的社会标签(标签错误0. 325),而不是检测器,让这些学生退缩.

blocks.en:
When evaluated using their own labels on validation, students trained on copy-B (0.174) and on the no-leak VLM (0.172) appear better than the annotation-trained student (0.210).
Compared with the annotation, however, their errors rise to 0.303 and 0.325 ( Fig. 3 ; ViT-Tiny).
A student that fits its teacher well can still be a poor gaze model; error should therefore be measured on annotated data, however small the sample.
blocks.zh:
在使用自己的认证标签进行评估时,接受过B版(0.174)和无漏VLM(0.172)培训的学生看起来比受过注释培训的学生(0.210)好。
然而,与注释相比,它们的错误上升到0.303和0.325(图3;Vit-Tiny)。
适合其老师的学生仍然可能是一个差的目光模型;因此,应该根据附加说明的数据来衡量错误,无论样本如何小。

blocks.en:
ADE rewards hedging towards the image centre.
The VLM+OVD students (no leak, gated, random swap) reach their best validation score at epoch 1 or 2, when their prediction spread (standard deviation of predictions over that of the annotation) has collapsed to just 0.05-0.37 of the annotation’s, compared with 0.76-0.83 for the annotation-trained student.
This can produce misleading rankings: random-swap students outperform leaky-VLM students on ADE (0.261 vs 0.291) yet achieve a PCK .1 only marginally above a constant centre predictor (0.069 vs 0.061).
We therefore recommend reporting prediction spread and PCK alongside ADE.
blocks.zh:
ADE奖励对图像中心的套期保值.
VLM+OVD学生(不漏,门,随机互换)在第1或第2个纪元时达到最佳验证分数,当他们的预测传播(预测的标准偏差大于注释的偏差)已经崩溃到只有注释的0.05-0.37,而对于经过注释训练的学生来说则是0.76-0.83.
这可以产生误导性的排名:随机扫射的学生在ADE(0.261 vs 0.291)上超越了漏泄的VLM学生,然而却仅仅在恒定中心预测器(0.069 vs 0.061)上略高于PCK 1.
因此,我们建议报告预测传播和PCK以及ADE。

blocks.en:
Every student also predicts whether the target is off-screen; this head is trained on the annotated flag for every source.
At the default 0.5 threshold, F1 is only 0.13 (annotation-trained ViT-Tiny); with the threshold chosen on validation, 0.32 (choosing on the test rows would give 0.36).
Every source improves in the same way (F1 0.07-0.18 at 0.5, 0.23-0.35 with the validation threshold), because off-screen targets are rare in validation (2.4% of rows, against 11.5% on test) and the head’s scores rarely reach 0.5.
We evaluate temporal heads that read the previous eight frames to predict gaze 100-500 ms ahead (supplementary) across 72 ViT-Tiny runs (8 sources × \times 3 seeds × \times 3 horizons; every source except the gated, random-swap and image-centre ones; Table 7 ).
With the head architecture picked on the test rows, and rows treated as independent, the heads surpass copying the static prediction forward on object gaze in 50 of 72 runs.
However, selecting architectures on a held-out fold and estimating uncertainty across clips reduces this count to 28, of which 27 arise from the three biased label sources (leaky VLM, copy-B, no-leak VLM).
For the leaky VLM, the apparent gain reflects static bias correction rather than anticipation, as a one-parameter correction towards the dataset mean does as well (0.269 vs 0.270 for the head, at 100 ms).
Even on windows where gaze changes position (12% at 500 ms), the annotation-trained student’s eight-frame head performs no better than the corresponding single-frame model (+0.001 ADE, not significant).
ViT-Small shows the same pattern: heads on annotation, MTGS and Gaze-LLE students are never significantly better than copying the static prediction forward (0 of 9 runs each); gains appear only for biased students (no-leak VLM, 9 of 9 on object gaze).
Training the student and the temporal head end to end does not help either (ViT-Tiny, annotation labels, 300 ms: 0.208 vs 0.208 for copying forward; no seed significant).
blocks.zh:
每个学生还预测目标是否是离屏;这个头在注释旗上为每个来源训练.
在默认的0.5阈值下,F1只有0.13(注解训练的ViT-Tiny);在验证时选择的阈值为0.32(在测试行上选择会给出0.36).
每个来源都有同样的改进(F1.07-0.18在0.5,0.23-0.35加上验证阈值),因为离屏目标在验证中是罕见的(排数的2.4%,测试时为11.5%),头部的分数很少达到0.5.
我们评价阅读前八帧的时间头,以预测在72个VIT-Tiny跑道(8个来源x\time 3个种子xxtime 3个地平线)前方100-500 ms的视线(补充);除闸门、随机扫描和图像中心外,每个来源;表7。
随着头部结构在测试排上被选中,而排被视作独立,头部在72跑中的50跑中超过了在物体视线上向前复制的静态预测.
然而,在悬浮的折叠上选择架构和估计各片段的不确定性,将这一计数降至28个,其中27个来自三个偏颇的标签来源(leaky VLM,副本-B,无漏 VLM).
对于漏出的VLM,表面增益反映了静态偏差的校正而不是预期,因为对数据集平均值的一参数校正也是如此(头部0.269对0.270,100ms).
即使是在视线改变位置(12%,500毫秒)的窗口上,经过注解训练的学生的八帧头部表现也不比相应的单帧模型(+0.001 ADE,不显著)好。
ViT-Small显示了同样的模式:在注释上的头,MTGS和Gaze-LE的学生从来就没有比将静态预测向前复制(每个9跑中的0跑);收益只出现在偏执的学生身上(无漏VLM,9跑中的9跑在物体视线上).
训练学生和时间头端端端端也无济于事(ViT-Tiny,注音标签,300ms:0.208 vs 0.208 for copy for extra;无种子显著).

blocks.en: 7. Limitations and conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 限制和结论

blocks.en:
For every source, including Gaze-LLE, both the head boxes and the off-screen flag come from the annotation, so a deployed system would still need a head detector.
We evaluate two zero-shot VLMs (InternVL3-8B, and Qwen3-VL-8B at label level only) with two prompt designs; improved prompting (e.g. a visual mark on the person [ 21 ] ) or fine-tuning [ 45 ] may narrow the gap to specialist models.
Tests are performed on two student sizes using one fixed training recipe and no per-source tuning.
None of the datasets represents a robot’s operational environment: all three are online videos, and no student was deployed on a robot.
MTGS was trained on VAT and ChildPlay (addressed by the VACATION check and by Gaze-LLE, Section 3 ), and DINOv2, InternVL3, Qwen3-VL and Grounding DINO were trained on web-scale data that may include frames from these public datasets.
The label check ranks coarse differences between teachers but does not separate teachers whose students lie within seed noise; ten clips identify the top two teachers but cannot determine their order.
Temporal experiments use frozen-feature heads plus one end-to-end student (ViT-Tiny, annotation labels); over 100-500 ms, gaze moves in few windows (12% at 500 ms), which limits how much any anticipation could show.
Why Gaze-LLE’s labels are easier for students to fit remains unclear.
Temporal smoothing by the teachers, clip-level annotation variability and centre bias were tested and do not account for it (supplementary material), whereas the roles of regularisation and of compatibility between label structure and student capacity remain untested.
Disentangling these mechanisms would help establish general principles for selecting and designing teachers beyond gaze estimation.
blocks.zh:
对于包括Gaze-LLE在内的每个来源,头盒和外屏旗都来自注释,所以部署的系统仍然需要头部探测器.
我们评价两个零镜头的VLM(InternVL3-8B,和只有标签级的Qun3-VL-8B),有两个即时设计;改进的即时(例如人物上的视觉标记[21])或微调[45]可能会缩小差距,变成专家模型.
使用一个固定的培训食谱对两个学生规模进行测试,不进行每源调试。
没有一个数据集代表机器人的操作环境:三个都是在线视频,没有学生被部署在机器人上.
MTGS接受了关于增值税和儿童养恤金的培训(通过VACATION检查和Gaze-LLE,第3节),DINOv2、InternVL3、Qune3-VL和Grounding DINO接受了关于网络尺度数据的培训,可能包括这些公共数据集的帧。
标签检查对教师之间的粗略差别进行排名,但不将学生处于种子噪声中的教师分开;十段片段确定前两名教师,但无法确定他们的顺序.
时间实验使用冷冻版头+一个端对端学生(ViT-Tiny,注解标签);超过100-500 ms,凝视在少数窗口中移动(12%,500 ms),这限制了任何预期能显示多少.
为何Gaze-LLE的标签更方便学生适应,
教师们对时间的平滑、剪贴级注释的可变性和中心偏差进行了测试,但没有对此做出解释(补充材料),而规范化的作用以及标签结构与学生能力之间的兼容性仍然没有测试。
将这些机制分开,将有助于为挑选和设计超出视线估计的教师确立一般原则。

blocks.en:
A specialist gaze model never trained on the target datasets’ gaze annotation can replace it for training lightweight students (comparable on ViT-Tiny, significantly more accurate on ViT-Small).
VLM-generated labels can reproduce a coordinate supplied in the prompt rather than reflect gaze reasoning; running a copy-the-coordinate baseline exposes this, and with the leak removed, both VLMs remain well behind a specialist.
The best teachers can be identified before any student is trained, by measuring label error on a few annotated clips.
Students should then be evaluated against the annotation, with spread and PCK reported alongside ADE, choices made on held-out data and differences tested by clip.
The same check can screen new teachers as they appear, and extending it to unlabelled robot video is a natural next step.
blocks.zh:
一个从未在目标数据集的凝视图上受过训练的专家凝视模型可以代替它来训练轻量级学生(比较ViT-Tiny,比ViT-Small更精确).
VLM生成的标签可以复制一个即时提供的坐标,而不是反映凝视推理;运行一个复制的坐标基线会暴露这一点,随着泄漏的清除,两个VLM都远远落后于一位专家.
在任何学生接受培训之前,可以通过在几个附加说明的片段上测量标签错误,确定最好的教师。
然后,应对照注释对学生进行评估,同时报告分布和PCK与ADE、对被搁置数据所作的选择以及用剪辑测试的差异。
同样的检查可以筛选出现的新教师,将其延伸至无标签的机器人视频是自然的下一步.

blocks.en:
Both VLMs (InternVL3-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B) receive the frame and a text prompt.
Decoding is greedy throughout, and Qwen3-VL-8B is run in bfloat16 precision.
The prompts below are used unchanged for both models.
Person B is the first other annotated person in the frame, in annotation-file order, and is chosen without reference to anyone’s gaze.
Frames with no second person occur only in VAT; there, the leaky pipeline falls back to the annotation (3.4% of VAT training rows).
Predictions are parsed from the first line matching GAZE_XY: (x, y) .
Coordinates outside [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] would indicate a format mismatch, but no InternVL3 no-leak prediction (about 498k) and no Qwen3-VL prediction falls outside [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ; the poor accuracy of the no-leak VLM therefore cannot be attributed to coordinate-format errors.
blocks.zh:
两种VLM(InternVL3-8B和Qune3-VL-8B)都收到帧和文本提示.
解码在整个过程中都是贪婪的,而Qwen3-VL-8B则以bfloat16精度运行.
下面的提示对于两种型号都没有变化.
个人 B是框中第一个其他注解人物,
没有第二人称的框架只出现在增值税中;在那里,漏泄的管道又回到注释中(增值税培训行的3.4%)。
预测从符合GAZEQY的第一行解析:(x,y).
外部坐标 [0,1] [0,1] 表示格式不匹配,但没有InternVL3 无漏预测(约498k)和没有Qune3-VL预测在 [0,1] [0,1] 之外;因此,无漏VLM的精度差不能归咎于坐标格式错误.

blocks.en:
For object rows, VLM+OVD first asks InternVL3 to name the target with the identification prompt below.
The name is passed to Grounding DINO (base), and the centre of the highest-scoring box is used as the label.
This prompt receives the whole frame and is not told whose gaze to estimate; when several people are present, the model must infer both which person is meant and what that person is looking at.
blocks.zh:

VLM+OVD identification prompt (InternVL3; object rows): Analysis Steps:
1. Examine the subject’s face orientation and precise eye/pupil direction.
2. Trace the vector of their gaze to find the MOST SPECIFIC point they are
   looking at -- this could be a person’s face, a person’s hand or another
   specific body part, an object, or entirely outside the visible frame.
3. If they are looking at a particular body part of a person (e.g. an
   outstretched hand, not that person’s face) -- identify that specific
   body part, not just the person. Only use a general person descriptor
   if no specific body part is the clear target.
4. Write 1-2 sentences of step-by-step reasoning.

If looking at a specific body part of a person (not their face/head):
Answer with the body part plus a brief visual descriptor of that person
(e.g. ’hand of man in green coat’, ’outstretched arm of woman in red’).
3-6 words maximum.
If looking at a person’s face/head, or at the person generally with no
specific body part evident: Answer with a brief visual descriptor of that
person only (e.g. ’person in gray suit’, ’woman on the right’, ’man with
beard’). 2-5 words maximum.
If looking at an object: Answer with ONLY the object name plus a brief
location hint if multiple similar objects exist (e.g. ’newspaper’, ’red
coffee mug’, ’plate on the left’). 2-5 words maximum.

PERSPECTIVE RULE: ALL location hints (left/right/etc.) must use the
VIEWER’s perspective looking AT the image -- NOT the subject’s own
left/right, and NOT any other person’s left/right. Worked example: if a
photo shows three people and the middle person’s own right hand points
toward the person standing on the LEFT side of the photo as the viewer
sees it, the correct answer is ’person on the left’ (viewer’s left), even
though it is the middle person’s OWN right hand doing the pointing. Always
describe positions exactly as a viewer looking at the photo would
describe them.
If looking off-screen: answer ’off-screen’.

blocks.en: Appendix B Student and training recipe

blocks.en:
The training configuration is identical across all label sources and both student sizes ( Table S1 ), with no per-source tuning.
The full image and the head crop are encoded by the same ViT backbone, and their class tokens are concatenated before prediction.
Training stops early when validation error against the source’s own labels has not improved for six epochs.

在所有标签来源和学生人数(表S1)中,培训配置相同,不进行每源调试。
完整的图像和头部作物由相同的ViT骨干编码,他们的类代币在预测前被压缩.
当对照来源自己的标签进行验证时,6个世纪的训练就提前停止了。

blocks.en: Appendix C Epoch selection on the annotation

blocks.en:
These are the same runs as in the main paper, but each source’s checkpoint is chosen by validation error against the annotation instead of its own labels: an oracle choice that a user without annotation cannot make.
For the annotation, MTGS and Gaze-LLE, the selected students’ test error is unchanged.
For weaker sources, annotation-based selection favours early checkpoints with collapsed predictions (e.g. epoch 1 for every no-leak VLM seed).

blocks.en: Appendix E Confidence gating at other thresholds
blocks.zh: 附录E 其他阈值的置信度

blocks.en:
Thresholds of 0.40, 0.48 and 0.55 replace 17%, 37% and 52% of detector labels with the annotation, respectively; random swap replaces the same share at random ( Table S6 ).
A threshold of 1 replaces every detector label and therefore has no random counterpart.
Across six comparisons (three thresholds and two student sizes), confidence gating is never significantly better than random replacement, while random replacement is significantly better in two cases (ViT-Tiny at 0.55, ViT-Small at 0.40).
At 0.48, one ViT-Tiny random-swap seed selects a late epoch (8), which widens its interval.
Once the students fit their labels (from epoch 2), random swap has lower validation error than confidence gating at every epoch, so the result is not an artefact of the selected epoch ( Table S7 ).

阈值0.40,0.48和0.55分别用注释取代了探测器标签的17%,37%和52%;随机互换则随机取代了相同的份额(表S6).
1的阈值取代每个探测器标签,因此没有随机对应.
在6个比较(3个阈值和2个学生大小)中,置信量标永远比随机置换要好得多,而随机置换则在2个案例中明显好得多(ViT-Tiny为0.55,ViT-Small为0.40).
0.48时,一个ViT-Tiny随机擦拭种子选择一个晚期(8),这拓宽了它的间隔.
一旦学生们符合了他们的标签(从时代2开始),随机互换的验证错误比信心在每一个时代的Gating要低,因此结果不是选定时代的动画(表S7).

blocks.en: Appendix F Why do Gaze-LLE’s labels train students as well as the annotation?
blocks.zh: 为何Gaze-LLE的标签会训练学生,

blocks.en:
Section 4 of the main paper shows that Gaze-LLE’s labels, despite a test label error of 0.114, train students as accurate as those trained on the annotation.
We test four possible explanations on the test rows (51,591 rows from 172 clips), where a pair is two consecutive frames of the same person.
Three are not supported; one is.
blocks.zh:
主论文第4节显示,Gaze-LLE的标签尽管测试标签错误为0.114,但培训学生的准确性与那些接受注释培训的学生一样.
我们在测试行上测试四种可能的解释(从172个夹片中测试51,591行),其中一对是同一人的连续两个帧.
三者不获支持;一者是.

blocks.en:
On stable pairs, where the smoothed annotation moves less than 0.01, the mean frame-to-frame step is 0.011 for the annotation, 0.025 for Gaze-LLE and 0.021 for MTGS; jitter, measured as the distance from each source’s own ± \pm 2-frame median, is 0.006, 0.012 and 0.010 respectively.
On shift pairs, where the smoothed annotation moves more than 0.05 (867 pairs), the mean step is 0.260 for the annotation, 0.102 for Gaze-LLE and 0.121 for MTGS ( Table S8 ).
The specialists’ labels therefore fluctuate more when gaze is stable and change less when it shifts, which indicates jitter and lag rather than greater temporal consistency.
The same pattern holds on all three datasets.
One caveat is that model labels are read from a 64 × 64 64{\times}64 heatmap, so they move in steps of at least 1/64 (about 0.016), which inflates their small movements.
blocks.zh:
在平滑的注释移动少于0.01的稳对子上,平均帧对帧步骤为:注解0.011,加泽-LLE0.025,MTGS0.021;按每个来源自身±\pm 2-帧中间值的距离测得的焦距分别为0.006,0.012和0.010.
换乘对上,平滑的注音移动超过0.05(867对),平均步数为注音0.260,Gaze-LLE0.102和MTGS0.121(表S8).
因此,专家的标签在视线稳定时波动较大,在视线变化时变化较少,这表明时局紧张和滞后,而不是时间一致性提高。
所有三个数据集都保持同样的模式。
一个警告是,模型标签是从64×64 64\times}64的热映射读来的,所以它们以至少1/64(约0.016)的步数移动,从而夸大了它们的小动作.

blocks.en:
For each of 165 clips (VAT 86, ChildPlay 43, VACATION 36; the test clips with at least 20 annotated rows and 10 consecutive-frame pairs), Gaze-LLE’s advantage is the annotation-trained student’s error minus the Gaze-LLE-trained student’s error.
After controlling for dataset, the share of gaze shifts, target motion and the share of social gaze, the partial Spearman correlation between this advantage and the clip’s annotation jitter is − - 0.06 [ − - 0.21, 0.10] for ViT-Tiny and 0.08 [ − - 0.06, 0.23] for ViT-Small, and the advantage is flat across low-, medium- and high-jitter clips.
This analysis measures variability in the test annotation rather than in the training annotation.
blocks.zh:
对于165个剪辑(VAT 86,ChildPlay 43,VACATION 36;测试剪辑至少有20个注释行和10个连续帧对),Gaze-LLE的优点是经过注解训练的学生错误减去经过Gaze-LLE训练的学生错误.
在控制数据集后,视线转移、目标运动和社会视线的占比,这种优势与片段的注解焦虑之间的部分Spearman相关关系为:Vit-Tiny为−-0.06 [−0.21,0.10],Vit-Small为0.08 [−-0.06,0.23],优势为平整的低、中、高片片片段。
这种分析在测试注释中而不是在培训注释中衡量变异性。

blocks.en:
The spatial spread of the annotation, Gaze-LLE and MTGS labels is similar (standard deviation in x x / y y : 0.194/0.252, 0.189/0.245 and 0.194/0.244), as is their mean distance from the image centre (0.294, 0.287 and 0.292).
The students are equally centre-biased: ViT-Tiny students trained on the annotation and on Gaze-LLE predict at mean distances of 0.212 and 0.218 from the centre.
The exception is VACATION, where Gaze-LLE’s labels are more central than the annotation (0.253 vs 0.284).
blocks.zh:
注释,Gaze-LLE和MTGS标签的空间分布类似(标准偏差为xx / y y:0.194/0.252,0.189/10.245和0.194/0.244),它们与图像中心的平均距离也相似(0.294,0.287和0.292)。
学生同样具有中心偏见:ViT-Tiny学生接受了关于注释和Gaze-LLE的培训,预测中距离中心0.212和0.218。
例外是VACATION,Gaze-LLE的标签比注释(0.253 vs 0.284)更为中心.

blocks.en:
Gaze-LLE-trained students reproduce their own labels more closely than annotation-trained students reproduce the annotation: 0.191 vs 0.208 for ViT-Tiny and 0.172 vs 0.196 for ViT-Small, both significant ( Table S9 ).
Annotation-trained students are also closer to Gaze-LLE’s labels (0.200) than to the annotation itself (0.208); this is descriptive only, with no interval.
Both observations are consistent with Gaze-LLE providing a signal that is easier for a lightweight student to learn.
blocks.zh:
Gaze-LLE训练的学生复制自己的标签比注解训练的学生复制得更贴近. 注释:ViT-Tiny0.191 vs 0.208,ViT-Small0.172 vs 0.196,两者都很重要(表S9)。
受注解训练的学生也更接近Gaze-LLE的标签(0.200)而不是注解本身(0.208);这只是描述性的,没有间隔.
这两种观察都与Gaze-LLE一致,提供了轻量级学生更容易学习的信号.

blocks.en: Appendix G Second VLM
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en:
Qwen3-VL-8B is evaluated on the same on-screen test rows (all three datasets) with the same two prompts as InternVL3; no students are trained on its labels.
Compared with InternVL3, Qwen3-VL-8B has lower label error with both prompts (Qwen3-VL minus InternVL3, paired clip bootstrap: leaky − - 0.037 [ − - 0.060, − - 0.020]; no-leak − - 0.087 [ − - 0.107, − - 0.067]).
With the leaky prompt, the difference is not significant on VACATION ( − - 0.010 [ − - 0.025, +0.005]).
The copying rate is lowest on ChildPlay, where Qwen3-VL reproduces the supplied coordinate on 60.5% of rows.
There, its leaky labels on object rows are more accurate than copy-B’s (0.282 vs 0.391), which is the main reason its pooled leaky label error is below copy-B’s (0.249 vs 0.284; main paper, Sec. 5). Table S10 gives both models’ copy rates for each dataset.

blocks.en: Appendix H Choosing a teacher from a few validation clips
blocks.zh: 附录 H 从一些验证片段中选择一位老师

blocks.en:
The label check uses validation clips only, so no test data informs the choice of teacher.
Its population is the 42,170 on-screen validation rows from 82 clips (VAT 27, ChildPlay 23, VACATION 32).
For each sample size k k (3, 5, 10, 20 and 40 clips), we repeat the following 2,000 times: draw k k of the 82 clips at random, without replacement; compute the label error of each of the ten sources other than the annotation on those clips; and record whether MTGS and Gaze-LLE have the two lowest errors, and the Spearman correlation between the ten label errors and the students’ test error ( Table S11 ). Table S12 gives each source’s label error on all 82 validation clips: the values behind ρ = 0.91 \rho=0.91 in the main paper.

其人口为来自82个片段(VAT 27,ChildPlay 23,VACATION 32)的42,170个屏幕验证列.
对于每个样本大小的kk(3、5、10、20和40个剪辑),我们重复以下2,000次:随机抽取82个剪辑中的kk,而不进行替换;计算除这些剪辑上的注释之外10个来源中的每个来源的标签错误;记录MTGS和Gaze-LE是否有两个最低的错误,以及10个标签错误与学生测试错误之间的斯皮尔曼关联(表S11)。 表S12给出了所有82个验证剪辑中每个来源的标签错误:主纸的后面值=0.91\rho=0.91.

blocks.en: Appendix I Off-screen detection
blocks.zh: 附录一 屏幕外检测

blocks.en:
Every student’s off-screen output is trained on the annotated flag, whatever the source of the coordinate labels.
The threshold is selected on validation by maximising F1 and then applied unchanged to the test set; we also report F1 at a fixed threshold of 0.5 and at the test-oracle optimum, an upper bound ( Table S13 ).
Off-screen targets make up 2.4% of validation rows and 11.5% of test rows, and all of them come from VAT.
At 0.5, F1 is poor for every source because the head’s scores rarely reach 0.5.
blocks.zh:
每个学生的外屏输出都用标注的旗帜进行训练,无论坐标标签的来源如何.
在验证时通过最大化F1来选择阈值,然后对测试集不加修改地应用;我们还报告F1的固定阈值为0.5,在测试-甲骨文优化时为上限(表S13.
外屏目标占验证行的2.4%,测试行的11.5%,全部来自增值税.
0.5分,每个来源的F1都很差,因为头的分数很少达到0.5分.

blocks.en: Appendix J Temporal prediction
blocks.zh: 附录J 时间预测

blocks.en:
Each frame is represented by a frozen static student’s 128-dimensional embedding and predicted gaze point.
A temporal head receives eight consecutive frames (about 270-330 ms) and predicts the annotated gaze point 100, 300 or 500 ms after the last frame.
Windows are taken from the test clips only, with a stride of four frames (12,441 windows from 175 clips at 100 ms), because on the training clips the static students’ predictions are fitted to frames they were trained on.
The temporal manifests contain 41 VACATION test clips, against 38 in the static evaluation (VAT and ChildPlay match), so the temporal analysis covers 175 clips rather than 172.
We evaluate four temporal architectures: a GRU, a Transformer, and residual versions of each, which predict a correction to the last frame’s point.
All are trained with a smooth- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss, AdamW (learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} ), batch size 64 and a cosine schedule for up to 40 epochs.
blocks.zh:
每个框架都用冷冻的静态学生128维嵌入和预测视点来代表。
一个时间头连续获得8个帧(约270-330 ms),并预测最后一个帧后的注解凝视点100,300或500 ms.
Windows只取自测试剪辑,有四个帧(175个剪辑的12 441个窗口,100毫秒),因为在培训剪辑上,静态学生的预测被安装在他们所训练的帧上。
时间表包含41个VACATION测试片段,相对于静态评价中的38个(VAT和ChildPlay匹配),因此时间分析涵盖175片段而非172片段.
我们评价四个时间结构:一个GRU,一个变形器,以及每个版本的剩余版本,它们预测一个修正到最后一个帧点。
所有训练都有一个光滑的 -l 1\ell\\1}损失, AdamW(学习率 10 - 5 10\\\5}), 批量尺寸 64 和一个最多 40 个纪元的余弦表。

blocks.en:
Performance is estimated with five-fold cross-fitting over clips, stratified by dataset, using the same split for every run: three folds train the head, a fourth selects the epoch and architecture, and the fifth is predicted.
Every window therefore receives one out-of-fold prediction.
We compare against three baselines: copy-forward, which repeats the static prediction for the last frame and is deployable; the last-known annotation, an oracle that needs the annotation at test time; and the global mean.
For each window, we take the head’s error minus the copy-forward error; 95% intervals come from 10,000 resamples of clips.
blocks.zh:
性能以5倍的交叉搭配超剪辑进行估计,按数据集进行分级,每跑一次使用相同的分数:三折列车车头,四分之一选择时代和架构,第五个预测.
因此,每个窗口都收到一个超出预期的预测。
我们比较了三个基线:重复最后一个框架的静态预测并可以使用;最后已知的注释,即试验时需要注释的甲骨文;以及全球平均值。
对于每个窗口,我们取头部的误差减去抄袭错误;95%的间隔来自10,000个复刻片段。

blocks.en:
Three controls test where any gain comes from.
Shrink-to-mean moves the copy-forward point c c towards the dataset mean μ \mu , c + a ⁡ ( μ − c ) c+a(\mu-c) , where the shrink factor a a is a single number fitted on the other folds; it uses no temporal input.
The single-frame head uses the same architectures but sees only the last frame.
The end-to-end model trains the student and the head together (ViT-Tiny, annotation labels).
blocks.zh:
三个控制测试 任何收益来自哪里。
缩到正向移动复制前的 c c 向数据集表示 μ\mu , c + a + → (μ − c) c + a (\ mu-c),其中缩到的系数 a 是安装在其他折叠上的单个数字; 它不使用时间输入 。
单帧头采用相同的架构,但只看到最后一帧.
端对端模型将学生和头一起训练(ViT-Tiny,注释标签).

blocks.en:
On gaze-shift windows, where the annotated target moves more than 0.1, the heads beat copy-forward, but on the far more common stay windows they are no better, and slightly worse on average ( Table S16 ).
Because the eight-frame head matches the single-frame head on shift windows, the gain comes from the last frame, not from motion. Table S14 gives the results of the 72 ViT-Tiny runs for each source.
On ViT-Small, heads on annotation, MTGS and Gaze-LLE students are never significantly better than copy-forward ( Table S15 ), and end-to-end training gives no gain either ( Table S17 ).
For the leaky VLM, the main paper’s explanation of the gain as a correction towards the mean holds on ViT-Tiny, where shrink-to-mean matches the head (0.269 vs 0.270 at 100 ms), but not on ViT-Small, where the head is better (0.255 vs 0.266).
blocks.zh:
在视窗转动时,附加说明的目标移动超过0.1,头部向前跳动,但在更常见的停留窗口上,头部并不更好,平均稍差(表S16)。
由于八帧头在转向窗上与单帧头相匹配,因此收益来自最后一帧,而非运动. 表S14列出每个来源的72个ViT-Tiny运行结果。
在ViT-Small上,注头、MTGS和Gaze-LLE的学生从来没有比抄袭更好的(表S15),端到端培训也没有好处(表S17)。
对于泄密的VLM,主要论文对增益的解释是对ViT-Tiny上平均悬浮的校正,其中的缩写比对头(0.269对0.270对100ms),而不是在ViT-Small上,头部较好(0.255对0.266).

Δ \Delta = head minus copy-forward ADE; verdicts from a paired clip bootstrap.

blocks.en: Appendix K UCO-LAEO: a mutual-gaze-only test
blocks.zh: 附录K UCO-LAEO:只相互交流的测试

blocks.en:
UCO-LAEO is used only for evaluation; no student is trained on it.
It contains 18,726 rows, all showing mutual gaze between two people.
MTGS was trained on UCO-LAEO as part of its original training data.
Because every row contains mutual gaze, the other person’s face centre is almost always the correct target: copy-B’s labels are nearly identical to the annotation (label error 0.001).
As a result, copy-B gives the best students (ViT-Small ADE 0.109), and students trained on leaky VLM labels outperform annotation-trained students (0.138 vs 0.165; Table S18 ).
We therefore exclude UCO-LAEO from the main results, as its mutual-gaze-only structure rewards the shortcut under investigation rather than general gaze-target estimation.
blocks.zh:
UCO-LAEO只用于评价;没有学生接受过这方面的培训。
它包含18,726行,都表现出两个人之间的相互凝视.
MTGS作为原始培训数据的一部分接受了UCO-LAEO培训.
由于每行都包含相互的目光,对方的面部中心几乎总是正确的目标:复制-B的标签与注释(label error 001)几乎完全相同.
因此,Copy-B给最优秀的学生(ViT-Small ADE 0.109),而接受过漏射VLM标签培训的学生则超过受过注解培训的学生(0.138对0.165;表S18)。
因此,我们把UCO-LAEO排除在主要结果之外,因为其只相互交流的结构奖励了正在调查的捷径,而不是一般的目光目标估计。

blocks.en: Table S18 : Results on UCO-LAEO (never used for training). Label ADE against the annotation; student ADE (mean ± \pm sd over 3 seeds) and PCK .1 . Because every row shows mutual gaze, predicting the other person’s face centre is usually correct, so copy-B gives the strongest students. Every row is social, so VLM+OVD labels equal the VLM labels with the same prompt.
blocks.zh: 表S18:UCO-LAEO的结果(从未用于培训)。 标注ADE反对注解;学生ADE(平均值±\pm sd over 3 种子)和PCK 1. 因为每一行都显示相互的目光,预测对方的面部中心通常是正确的,因此复制-B给最强的学生. 每行都是社交的,所以VLM+OVD的标签与VLM的标签相同,具有相同的提示.

blocks.en: Appendix L Reproducibility notes
blocks.zh: 附录L 可复制性说明

blocks.en:
Repeated runs are bit-identical when executed on the same GPU partition type; changing partition type introduces variability comparable to that observed across random seeds.
Most ViT-Tiny students are trained on 1g.10gb A100 partitions; four runs (two Gaze-LLE seeds and two threshold-1 runs) use 3g.40gb partitions.
Labels are generated on a mixture of A100 partitions, full A100 GPUs and L40S GPUs; repeated greedy VLM inference can produce different outputs for a small percentage of rows.
Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
blocks.zh:
重复的运行在相同的GPU分区类型上执行时是位同位异位的;改变分区类型引入了可与随机种子间观察到的可变性相当的可变性.
大多数ViT-Tiny学生在1g.10gb A100分区上接受训练;4跑(2个Gaze-LLE种子和2个阈值-1跑)使用3g.40gb分区.
标签是在A100分区,全A100 GPU和L40S GPU的混合物上生成的;重复的贪婪VLM推论可以为小比例的行产生不同的输出.
守则一旦接受,将公布于众。
